ModMetaData.name: Tidy Toolbar – No More Cut-Off Tabs
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Too many mods, too many buttons on the bottom bar – and every label cut to "Brkng", "Správc", "Dědctv"?
Tidy Toolbar sorts the bar into groups. The game's own buttons stay on the bar, every button added by a mod goes into one "Mods" button that opens a menu. Make your own groups too ("Colony", "Info", "Fun" …).
- Every button on the bar gets the width its name needs; buttons with an icon take only the icon's width. - Right click a button: put it on the bar, into a group or a new group, move it left or right. - Right click a group: sort its buttons. - What still doesn't fit goes into "More". - Settings: a list of all buttons with their place and order. - Hotkeys work for every button, wherever it is. - The right side too: the same alert many times is shown once with ×N, the rest folds into "+N more", right click hides an alert; old letters go away by themselves; the play settings icons sit behind one button. - Safe to add to or remove from a save. English and Czech.
Mnoho modů, mnoho tlačítek na spodní liště? Tidy Toolbar je roztřídí do skupin: tlačítka ze hry zůstanou na liště, tlačítka z modů jsou v jednom tlačítku „Mody“, které otevře menu. Můžeš si udělat i vlastní skupiny. Pravým klikem tlačítko přesuneš na lištu nebo do skupiny, názvy už nejsou useknuté. Lze přidat i odebrat kdykoli.
